title: Backslashes in multi-line strings crash Godot Script Editor
body:
### Tested versions

- v4.7.stable.mono.win64
- v4.8.dev1.mono.win64

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev1.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K (24 threads) - 31.76 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The GDScript editor crashes a few second after pasting backslashed text into a multi-line string, here is the verbose output from v4.8, but it also occurs on the stable 4.7 release (on the same line in the cowdata.h file).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Copy this code into the GDScript editor:
```extends Node3D


# Called when the node enters the scene tree for the first time.
func _ready() -> void:
	
	var pre_prompt = """
		```
- "C:/Users/abc/Downloads" (Aliases: Downloads) C:\Users\abc\OneDrive\Code		
		"""
	pass # Replace with function body.


# Called every frame. 'delta' is the elapsed time since the previous frame.
func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	pass
```
2. Specifically, copying in this line causes it to crash:
```
- "C:/Users/abc/Downloads" (Aliases: Downloads) C:\Users\abc\OneDrive\Code
```
### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Visible in brand new project, but here is a copy from my system anyway.
